items.title: Russia agrees to resume trilateral peace talks on Ukraine war
items.description: A US envoy met Putin in Saint Petersburg on Wednesday after the Kremlin agreed to resume peace talks with Ukraine and the United States. Details by FRANCE 24's correspondent Gulliver Cragg.

items.title: Putin the Humanist? 10 Ways Russia Has Shown Its ‘Humanity’ in Ukraine
items.description: US envoy Steve Witkoff called Vladimir Putin a “humanist.” The record of Russia’s war against Ukraine includes the killings in Bucha, the bombing of Mariupol’s theater and maternity hospital, the transfer of Ukrainian children to Russia, torture of prisoners of war – and a baby killed in a stroller in a Russian drone s…

items.title: U.S. and Israel are planning for a possible attack on Iran, source tells NPR
items.description: The U.S. and Israel are preparing plans for a possible attack on Iran in early November, after the U.S. midterm elections, a person briefed on war planning told NPR. Iran said it is prepared.

items.title: War in Ukraine: Bolstered by Trump's support, Putin refuses to back down
items.description: Received by the Russian president near Saint Petersburg on Wednesday, Steve Witkoff, Donald Trump's envoy, praised the Russian leader, highlighting his 'humanitarian' profile. He left without securing any concessions from his host, who dismissed any idea of a truce with Kyiv.

items.title: Missiles hit Kyiv after Russia agrees to US call to resume Ukraine peace talks
items.description: Moscow says it is "ready in principle" to resume peace talks and US President Donald Trump says the world is "the closest we've been" to ending the war.

items.title: Trump, Putin and Xi at one table, without Ukraine. What Moscow wants from the proposal and why Beijing might agree.
items.description: Moscow is pushing for a summit with Donald Trump and Xi Jinping to discuss ending the war in Ukraine, without Kyiv or the EU. What does Russia hope to gain, and why might China be willing to take part?

items.title: Trump, forse siamo più vicini che mai alla fine della guerra in Ucraina
Putin Releases American Jailed in Russia, Agrees to Trilateral Peace Talks as Witkoff Visits
items.description: The Kremlin said that renewed peace negotiations with the United States and Ukraine could take place in Abu Dhabi as early as next month.

items.title: Sudan conflict: Peace efforts resume to end ‘drone war’ fuelling humanitarian crisis
items.description: Talks to halt the fighting in Sudan and alleviate the humanitarian crisis there continued in Geneva on Wednesday, where nearly two dozen countries convened to discuss a pathway to a ceasefire and transition to peaceful governance that represents all Sudanese people.

items.title: After Witkoff Meeting, Putin 'Ready To Resume' US-Led Peace Talks With Ukraine
items.description: Russian President Vladimir Putin told US envoy Steve Witkoff that Moscow was willing to resume stalled, US-mediated peace talks with Ukraine, Kremlin foreign policy aide Yury Ushakov said after the two met at Constantine Palace in St. Petersburg.
